The right side of this page is blank. Small section numbers (12, 13, 14, 15) stand at the left edge of the column.

main_text.p: 12Merito excommunicari eos, qui citati vocati venire noluerunt ad concilium legitimum. resp. Tridentinum autem non fuisse legitimum docuimus antea. deinde potestantes non potuerunt venire Tridentum, sine evidenti capitis periculo: quia antequam essent auditi, fuerunt damnati; testibus actis concilii, & toto eius processu. 13Rectius fecisse prote-stantes, si causam suam publicè in pleno con-cilio defendissent. resp. Quod dixi, non licuit: quia non alii fuerunt annumerati patribus, quàm jurati pontificis Romani, neq; libera fuerunt suffragia. 14Decuisse protestantes, ut etiam cum capitis periculo causam suam de-fendissent. resp. Si ita conduxissent ad Dei gloriam & ecclesiae aedifica-cationem: rectius autem tum principes tum doctores ecclesiarū prospexerunt gregi sibi comisso, quòd substituerunt in suis territoriis, atque argumentis firmis ac solidis demonstrarunt illius concilii Tridentini nullitatem. 15Decere omnes & singu-
[Marginal strip of facing page: illegible, ~60 letters]

page.notes: The left strip shows the outer margin of the facing page 128 and is cropped too far to read; it is marked illegible above. Section numbers 12–15 are printed at the left edge of the column and are given as notes. The catchword "los" completes "singu-los" from the last line. The line "Decere omnes & singu-" is italic in the scan. The text is one continuous paragraph with no printed indents. Ecclesiarū is read with a doubtful macron (ecclesiatū on the scan), so ecclesiarū should be checked against the image.
